# MYFUNDBOX

> MYFUNDBOX is EU-based revenue management software built in Germany for CFOs, controllers, and RevOps teams to track, recognize, forecast, and report recurring revenue.

- Entity: MYFUNDBOX ([ADD: MYFUNDBOX Legal Entity GmbH])
- Headquarters: Germany [ADD: City & Street Address]
- Residency & Compliance: [CONFIRM: Frankfurt am Main, Germany (AWS eu-central-1 / EU ISO-27001 region)]; IFRS 15, German HGB/GoBD, GDPR, EU VAT separation
- Product Boundary: Revenue management sub-ledger, recognition, recurring analytics, and forecasting. NOT a payment processor, payment gateway, or billing engine.
- Default Currency: EUR
